title: When does a rectangle fit into an n-dimensional box? An explicit criterion with a formal proof
description:
An explicit necessary and sufficient condition for a rectangle to fit, after an arbitrary rigid motion, into an n-dimensional rectangular box, for every n ≥ 2 (the case k = 2 of the fitting problem of Jerrard and Wetzel). The repository contains the paper (English and Russian), a complete formal proof in Lean 4 / Mathlib, and a reference implementation of the criterion in Python.
